description: This script manages the 'potd' (password of the day) service, including starting, stopping, and restarting the service, and reacting to system events such as WAN status and link state. It sources external configuration and logging functions, and interacts with system services via command-line tools.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the potd service, ensuring the system time is valid before launching the password daemon, and sets the service status to 'started'.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the potd service and updates the service status to 'stopped'.
